ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 70-75% of the visible surface, with a central low-intensity (black) region occupying the remaining 25-30%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white areas dominate the lateral lobes. A central, low-intensity black anchor-shaped region is centered on the median notch. The trailing edges exhibit a continuous low-intensity black margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 90-100 degrees, positioned at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude oscillations along the trailing edge. Pronounced jagged peaks are visible at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge trajectory curving upward and outward toward acute terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters are visible at the extreme distal tips, particularly the right tip, indicating surface irregularity.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, near-parallel dark linear streaks are visible on the left white lobe, oriented vertically between the central dark region and the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notches/indentations along the trailing edge contour; vertical linear pigmentation streaks on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation forms a distinct, symmetrical 'anchor' or 'W' shape at the junction of the lobes.
